dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

format.description: Specifies the format options of the param kind

valueType.description:
Specifies how to transform the extracted value. The default is string, but depending on the use case
it may be useful to transform the value to a value type like numbers, arrays, etc.

id.description: The id of the component to inspect

path.description:
The path from the root state of the id to the desired value.
Each level in the state should be traversed through a dot (.) delimiter. Ex: 'c3arguments.arg1.field1'

Must target an array of objects

action.description:
javascript action (expression) to perform on the state information.
References to the state path object can be made through 'statePathValue' variable.
The output of the action is expected to be stringifiable.

elementValuePath.description:
Specifies the path to the value of the elements in the targeted object array.
This specifies what values the keys of #filterConditions should have.

filterConditions.description:
For each element in the object array whose value at #elementValuePath is a key of `filterConditions`, only render
this element if at least one of matching UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam(s) extracts a truthy value.

title:
A {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam} that takes an JS object array from a component's configuration
and filters this array down based on #filterConditions that are specified for specific objects in this array.

It is intended to be used with [derived props](UiSdlConnected#derivedProps).

This type does not work for filtering out [component refs](UiSdlComponentRef). For filtering out component
refs, use {@link UiConfigComponent}s.
name: UiFilterComponentConfigByDynamicValueParam
